raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step keeps only rows where ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours. From batch 3 on, about 20% of each batch arrives roughly 3 days after txn_ts, so those valid POSTED rows are silently dropped. txn_ids are all distinct, so there are no duplicates to guard against. The lateness filter is undocumented, so the fix removes it and keeps the status filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
